# Project name

One line on what this project is.

Created from [ai-sdlc-loop](https://github.com/mitulamin/ai-sdlc-loop) with the `solo` profile. Edit this file first.

- `AGENTS.md` is the short rules file your agents read every session.
- `PROCESS.md` says how work moves from idea to merged. It is the part that changes by profile.
- `CHANGELOG.md` is where you note what changed and why.
